title: staged-init-verifier-and-helm-overlay-templating-for-onprem-preflight
author: Marta González
release_notes: Adds a staged preflight verifier and a compact Helm overlay templating DSL for on-prem installer workflows. No behavioral changes to default installs; new fields are opt-in.
description: Motivation: on-prem installs vary by cluster operational constraints (kubelet disk/eviction behavior, nodes with long provision times, and network overlays). Teams repeatedly built ad-hoc preflight scripts that run as init jobs and then separately maintain overlay templates per customer. This PR introduces a small, declarative preflight verifier plus a compact Helm overlay templating DSL to reduce duplication and provide safer staged init execution for Private installs. Summary of changes: 1) charts/private/values.schema.json: extend schema with 'preflightProfiles' and 'nodeProfiles' objects; document expected probes (diskPressureThresholdPct, kubeletVersionMin, maxPodsObserved). 2) templates/preflight-verifier-job.yaml: a templated Job that reads the chosen preflightProfile and runs a sequence of checks (kubelet version, ephemeral-storage, nodeReady jitter, custom script hooks). The job emits structured annotations on success/failure for the installer controller to read. 3) templates/10-init-stager.yaml: a small controller job template that sequences multiple initializers using a stage annotation; it supports a 'cordonAware' flag to avoid draining nodes during image pre-pulls in sensitive clusters. 4) templates/_overlay_helper.tpl: a compact DSL with include functions for per-cluster networkPolicy overlays and nodeSelector composition; supports merging of overlay maps with precedence rules. 5) scripts/node-check.sh: lightweight shell probe used by the verifier to report node-level metrics in a k8s-friendly JSON line format. 6) charts/README.md: new section documenting how to author preflightProfiles and overlays and recommended patterns for slow-provisioning hardware. Commits: - 5a3d2c4: add values.schema fields and documentation - b78f9e1: implement preflight-verifier job and basic probes - 9f1a4d7: introduce overlay helper tpl and README examples - c2b7d99: add cordon-aware init stager and node-check script - 17e6b55: tests and CI fixes, address reviewer feedback Changed areas (high-level): charts/private/values.schema.json, templates/preflight-verifier-job.yaml, templates/10-init-stager.yaml, templates/_overlay_helper.tpl, scripts/node-check.sh, charts/README.md, tests/helm/preflight-profiles.yaml Test/CI notes: initial CI run (helm-lint) failed due to schema strictness; fixed by tightening required/optional fields and adding examples. Helm-unit and lint passed on rerun. E2E preflight integration runs in CI against a small KinD harness; first run surfaced a timing race in the staged runner which was resolved by a short backoff and idempotent sidecar wait. Merge strategy: squash and merge after approvals and green CI. Usage notes: new installs that opt into 'preflightProfiles' will run the verifier Job before the init-stager executes image pre-pulls or DB migrations. The overlay DSL is intentionally small; it is not a full templating language but provides safe merges for networkPolicy overlays and nodeSelector maps. Backwards compatibility: default values keep prior behavior; fields are opt-in. Docs: README updates include example preflightProfile for SSD vs HDD-backed nodes and a cluster overlay example for a corporate network with restricted egress.

review_comments: Samir: Can the verifier run with a customizable timeout? If not, clusters with slow API servers will fail the profile check.
Marta: Added a per-profile timeout key and a global default in values.schema.json. Timeouts default to 2m to be conservative.
Alyssa: The overlay helper looks useful but we need to ensure the precedence merge rule is documented; also please add unit tests for map merges.
Marta: Added README examples and unit tests in tests/helm/preflight-profiles.yaml demonstrating merge precedence and fallbacks.
Noah: Approving after CI is green and minor nits fixed in template comments.
CI Bot: helm-lint failed on first run due to schema 'required' misconfig; rerun succeeded after fix.
notes_for_ops: When enabling preflightProfiles in a large fleet, stagger profile rollouts to avoid API server contention.
Recommend enabling 'cordonAware' only in clusters where node drains are disruptive; otherwise leave false for faster pre-pulls.
Validate custom overlay maps with 'helm template --values <file> --debug' to avoid unintended label/selector merges.
